User is preparing a supply order for the Jorton depot.
- Add 120 lanterns to the order.
- Task: Send Vik, Leon, Suri, and Dell notes from respective meetings.
- People Out: Jonah (Leon covering), Finn (Wren covering), Wren (Una covering).
- Desk Swaps: Mira/Dell, Opal/Cora, Ada/Kira, Nils/Opal, Leon/Nils, Leon/Cora, Mira/Suri.
- Review Preferences: Leon (east wing), Suri (garden studio), Rafe (harbour room), Una (north office), Teo (library annex), Opal (loading bay), Hugo (east wing), Kira (east wing).
- Room Clear Requests: Nils (north office), Hugo (library annex), Wren (library annex), Teo (garden studio), Leon (garden studio), Pia (east wing), Suri (harbour room), Teo (north office).
- Repainting/Noise: Loading bay/east wing (morning/afternoon/evening), North office/print room (afternoon/morning), Harbour room (morning), Garden studio (afternoon), Print room (afternoon), Library annex (evening).
- Cold Rooms: Mira (east wing afternoon), Ada (loading bay morning), Esme (print room evening), Opal (garden studio afternoon), Ines (harbour room evening), Vik (print room evening), Nils (library annex evening), Wren (north office morning), Wren (harbour room afternoon).
- Working Coffee Machines: Library annex, east wing, garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, print room.
- Slow Lifts: Near east wing, library annex, harbour room, north office, garden studio.
- Stand-ups: Afternoon (garden studio), Evening (north office).
- Room Availability: Kira asked if harbour room is free in evening. Opal asked if garden studio is free in evening.
- Misc: Umbrella left in loading bay. Teo finds east wing too cold in afternoon.
